_note: Publication decisions, one record per map (scripts/record-approval.mjs). evidence_type says who stands behind each: OPERATOR_DECLARATION (the map author/operator) or INSTITUTIONAL_PERMISSION (a written permission). publish lists what may be published.

approvals.rights_basis: Operator declaration (2026-10-29): the operator recorded these maps with the Go2 robot and built them (FAST-LIO, LIO-SAM), knows of no school regulation, research-funding contract or access-controlled area that restricts their publication, and has the authority to decide their publication scope. This is not an institutional permission.
approvals.statement: Publication of the web view, rendered figures, research map file, trajectory (where one exists) and building set. Only geometric traces of people remain (no camera imagery); 4F cleaning candidates v1/v2 are not used.
